children: AI agent from its platform as part of a larger ban of third-party shopping bots.
Meta’s Muse was designed to help users perform online tasks that include scheduling, finding items online, and automating online tasks. Amazon

currently prohibits other AI agents from searching and shopping on its site, arguing that these tools can obtain sensitive customer information and do not properly identify themselves. As a result, Musa has been blocked since Sunday.
also worries the third-party bots jeopardize its lucrative ad business by bypassing its native storefront.

“We think it’s fairly straightforward that third-party applications that offer to make purchases on behalf of customers from other businesses should operate openly and respect service provider decisions about whether or not to participate,” Amazon spokesperson Lara Hendrickson said in an emailed statement to Bloomberg. “Agentic third-party applications such as Muse have the same [opt-in requirements], and we’ve requested that Meta remove Amazon from the experience.”
is part of a bigger effort by Amazon
to keep rival shopping bots from making purchases off its platform. In addition to Meta’s Muse, OpenAI’s ChatGPT
Gemini, and Perplexity’s Comet are also blocked from Amazon’s shopping platform.

title: Amazon blocks Meta's Muse from retail site
